requirements.summary: Build a form page to save new recorded lecture links with title, URL, notes, and label fields, showing confirmation after save
acceptanceCriteria: A form is available with fields: Title (required), URL (required), Notes (optional), Label/Category (optional).
Submitting the form saves the entry to the backend.
A success message is shown after a link is saved.
URL field validates that the input is a valid URL format.

file_operations.description: Create a page component with a form containing Title (text input, required), URL (text input with URL validation, required), Notes (textarea, optional), and Label/Category (text input, optional) fields. On submit, call backend.addRecording() with the form data. Show a success toast/message after successful save. Use shadcn/ui form components (Input, Textarea, Button, Label) for consistent styling. Handle loading and error states appropriately.

Create a reusable form component that handles lecture link input fields (title, url, notes, label), form validation (URL format check), submission logic, and success/error feedback. Use shadcn/ui form primitives and validation. Emit events or accept callbacks for form submission.
Add a route for /add-lecture that renders AddLecturePage. Ensure navigation to this page is accessible from the main layout or navigation menu.

requirements.summary: Build a drive-style list view displaying all saved lecture links with title, label badge, notes snippet, date, and open video button
acceptanceCriteria: All saved lecture entries are displayed in a list/card layout.
Each card shows: title, label badge, notes preview, date saved, and an 'Open Video' button.
Clicking 'Open Video' opens the link in a new browser tab.
The list updates immediately after a new entry is saved.

file_operations.description: Create a page component that fetches all lecture recordings from the backend using backend.getAllRecordings(). Display them in a card-based list layout. Each card shows title, label/category badge, notes snippet (truncated if long), formatted creation date, and an 'Open Video' button that opens the URL in a new tab (target='_blank'). Use shadcn/ui Card components for layout. Include loading and empty states.

Create a card component that displays a single lecture entry: title (prominent), label badge (colored tag), notes preview (ellipsis for overflow), formatted date, and an 'Open Video' button. The button opens the lecture URL in a new tab. Use shadcn/ui Card, Badge, and Button components. Accept a Recording object and optional delete callback as props.

Create a custom React hook that fetches lecture recordings from the backend, manages loading/error states, and provides a refetch function. Return { lectures, loading, error, refetch }. Use backend.getAllRecordings() for data fetching.
Add a route for /lectures (or set as default route /) that renders LectureListPage. Ensure this route is the main landing page or accessible from navigation.

requirements.summary: Add search and filter functionality to lecture list by title/notes keyword and label/category
acceptanceCriteria: A search bar filters displayed entries by title or notes content in real time.
A label/category filter dropdown narrows results to the selected tag.
Clearing the search/filter restores the full list.

file_operations.description: Add a search input field and label/category filter dropdown above the lecture card list. Implement client-side filtering logic: search bar filters by title or notes (case-insensitive substring match), label dropdown filters by exact tag match. Update the displayed lecture list in real-time as filters change. Allow clearing filters to show all entries. Use shadcn/ui Input and Select components.

Create a filter component containing a search input (for title/notes keyword) and a label/category dropdown (populated with unique tags from all lectures). Accept current filter values and onChange callbacks as props. Use shadcn/ui Input and Select components for consistent styling.

Extend the hook to support client-side filtering. Add search and selectedLabel parameters. Return filtered lectures based on search query (title/notes match) and selected label. Maintain original full list for filter reset.

requirements.summary: Allow users to delete a saved lecture link entry from the list view with confirmation
acceptanceCriteria: A delete button is present on each lecture entry card.
Clicking delete removes the entry from the backend and the UI updates immediately.
A confirmation prompt is shown before deletion.

file_operations.description: Add a delete button (icon or labeled button) to each lecture card. When clicked, show a confirmation dialog (using shadcn/ui AlertDialog) asking the user to confirm deletion. On confirmation, call backend.removeRecording(id) and invoke a callback to refresh the lecture list. Handle loading state during deletion.
Add a deleteLecture function that calls backend.removeRecording(id) and refetches the lecture list. Return this function from the hook for use in components.

requirements.summary: Apply a clean, modern notebook/drive-inspired visual theme with warm neutral tones, card-based layout, readable typography, and subtle iconography
acceptanceCriteria: All pages use a consistent warm neutral color palette.
Cards have clean borders, subtle shadows, and clear typographic hierarchy.
Label badges use distinct accent colors for visual differentiation.
The UI feels organized and drive/notebook-like throughout.

file_operations.description: Update global styles to use a warm neutral color palette (cream, amber, slate backgrounds, warm text colors). Define CSS custom properties for primary, secondary, accent, and muted colors in the :root selector. Ensure typography uses readable fonts with clear hierarchy (larger headings, appropriate line-height). Apply these theme colors to shadcn/ui component CSS variables.

Extend the Tailwind theme to include warm neutral color palette (cream, amber, slate) as custom colors. Configure primary, secondary, accent, and muted color scales. Set default fonts to a clean, readable sans-serif stack. Ensure these colors integrate with shadcn/ui theming.

Create a layout component that wraps all pages with consistent header/navigation and warm neutral background styling. Include navigation links to Add Lecture and Lecture List pages. Use subtle folder/bookmark icons in the header (e.g., from lucide-react). Apply cream/amber tones to the background and slate for text/borders. Use shadcn/ui layout patterns.
Wrap all routes with the Layout component to ensure consistent theme and navigation across all pages.

Style the card component with clean borders, subtle shadows, and warm neutral tones. Use distinct accent colors for label badges (e.g., amber-500, slate-600) to differentiate categories. Ensure clear typographic hierarchy (larger title, smaller date/notes). Apply card styling consistent with drive/notebook aesthetic.

Wire the generated logo image (flat illustration of a bookmarked notebook with a play button, warm amber and cream tones) into the app header/navigation as a branding element. Reference this image in the Layout component header using the workspace file path frontend/public/assets/generated/lecture-vault-logo.dim_256x256.png as a static asset.
